signal.rationale: Firm purchase order received for about 10.00 crore of agricultural commodities, about 3.8x FY2026 revenue of 2.62 crore, so the size test is passed by a wide margin. Not routine: no comparable order is disclosed and revenue fell for three years. Open questions are the trading counterparty, the likely thin trade margin and whether the order is one-off, so this is a low-confidence DEEP_RESEARCH and not evidence of an earnings uplift.
